category.description: The preliminary or published category this per-category registry file extends. It must equal the filename stem.

products.description: Signal-only tail products. They carry identity and addressable artifacts but no editorial scores, and are excluded from the public scored map until promoted.

homepage.description: URL convention (#525): `pattern` requires an http(s) scheme followed by a dotted hostname made of label characters (letters, digits, hyphens), an optional port, and then a path, query, fragment or the end of the string. The bare string `https://` fails here rather than shipping as a link nobody can follow, and so do `https://?a.b`, `https://#a.b` and `https://user.name@`, where the only dotted text is a query, a fragment or userinfo rather than a host. `http://localhost` fails too (no dot); a dotted IPv4 host passes. `pattern` and not `format: uri`, because build/validate.py calls jsonschema.validate with no format checker and a `format` would assert a check nobody runs. Measured 2026-09-11 against this pattern: 5,635 http(s) strings under sources/ (products, organizations, scores, registry), 0 rejected.
